activity.notes: Houston assumed the Texas governorship on 21 December 1859. The Texas secession convention removed him from office on 16 March 1861 after he refused an oath of loyalty to the Confederate States; ATLAS ends the Activity at that actual removal.

sources.title: Houston, Sam — Handbook of Texas Online, Texas State Historical Association
sources.citation_text: The Texas State Historical Association gives Houston's two Republic of Texas presidential terms and his later Texas governorship, including his removal on 16 March 1861 after refusing the Confederate loyalty oath.
